project_type: React Native / Expo mobile app + Node.js/Express/MongoDB REST backend, greenfield monorepo
build_system: Two independent npm workspaces: mobile/ uses Expo CLI (npx expo start / npx expo export), server/ uses plain Node.js (node src/server.js or npm start). No root-level build script.
test_framework: No test framework required in Phase 1. Smoke-test by: (a) starting the server and hitting /api/health with curl, (b) running the seedAdmin script, (c) starting the Expo app and confirming it bundles without errors.
build_command: server: cd server && npm install && node src/server.js   |   mobile: cd mobile && npm install && npx expo start
test_command: Server health check: curl http://localhost:5000/api/health   |   Admin seed: cd server && node scripts/seedAdmin.js   |   Mobile bundle: npx expo export --platform android (or npx expo start --no-dev --minify)
verification_instructions: 1. cd server && npm install — exits 0. 2. Set server/.env (copy .env.example, fill MONGO_URI with a local/Atlas URI and JWT_SECRET). 3. node scripts/seedAdmin.js — prints 'Admin seeded'. 4. node src/server.js — prints 'MongoDB connected' and 'Server running on port 5000'. 5. curl http://localhost:5000/api/health — returns {status:'ok'}. 6. cd mobile && npm install — exits 0. 7. npx expo export --platform android -- exits 0 (bundle succeeds).
environment_constraints: Windows host (PowerShell). Expo SDK 51+. All file paths relative to c:\Users\Dell\Desktop\PROWASH (the workspace root). Never write files outside this root. Do not use TypeScript. Do not use Firebase or Supabase. Do not restart any running dev server.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project — no existing AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md. Follow the project spec in the original user request: JS-only, Expo-compatible libraries, no web-only components, SecureStore for tokens, role-based auth.
key_patterns: Backend: ES modules (type:module in package.json), controllers import models directly, middleware/auth.js exports protect (JWT verify) and requireAdmin (role check), errorHandler.js is the last Express middleware. Mobile: all screens are functional components using hooks, theme imported from src/theme/, components are in src/components/, API calls go through src/services/api.js (axios instance), AuthContext wraps the app and exposes { user, token, login, logout, loading }.
directory_structure: PROWASH/ (workspace root) — mobile/ (Expo app, all source in mobile/src/) — server/ (Express API, all source in server/src/) — .agents/tasks/ (planning artifacts, never committed to the app). README.md at root.
